description: This file is a detailed documentation and overview of the HDMIOutput Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) interface. It includes specifications, capabilities, operation scenarios, event handling, state machines, and platform capabilities for the HDMI output subsystem in a media platform. It provides guidance for implementation, capabilities negotiation, and recovery strategies, especially focusing on HDCP authentication and sink connection scenarios.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported features, video modes, pixel formats, HDR, HDCP, and other capabilities of an HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the HDCP authentication state (e.g., AUTHENTICATED, UNAUTHENTICATED, UNKNOWN).

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration defining the HDR output mode (e.g., HDR10, HLG, AUTO).

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumeration identifying the source type for the Source Product Description InfoFrame.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Enumeration for HDMI Video ID Codes, defining various supported HDMI video modes.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a Capabilities object describing the supported features and formats of the specific HDMI output.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and begins configuring the HDMI output port.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops any ongoing output or configuration on the HDMI port.
